title: Multiplexed detection of febrile infections using CARMEN
core_idea: Develop three CARMEN (CRISPR-based combinatorial arrayed reactions for multiplexed evaluation of nucleic acids) panels targeting viral hemorrhagic fevers, mosquito-borne viruses, and sexually transmitted infections to collectively detect 23 pathogens, using deep learning to design assays and evaluating them on synthetic targets, spiked serum, and patient samples.
tldr: The study develops and evaluates three deep learning–designed CARMEN multiplex panels for simultaneous detection of 23 pathogens across hemorrhagic, mosquito-borne, and sexually transmitted infections for clinical and surveillance applications.
